description: A `datetime` whose `tzinfo` gives a UTC offset, so it names one instant.
A `datetime` without offset information: a wall-clock reading that different machines interpret differently.
`astimezone` converts the same instant to another offset; `replace` keeps the wall clock and changes the instant.
An exact duration in days, seconds and microseconds; calendar months are not durations.
Returns the weekday of the first day and the number of days of a month, used to clamp month arithmetic.
Passing "now" (or a function returning it) into code instead of reading the system clock, so results are testable.
